default.rest: Fresh sugarcane is crushed soon after harvest to retain its natural flavour and goodness.
The juice is slowly cooked in traditional pans to develop the rich taste, aroma, and natural colour of jaggery.
The juice is carefully clarified using traditional methods without bleaching agents or harmful chemicals.
The jaggery is handled in clean, controlled environments with strict hygiene standards throughout the process.
Every batch is tested for quality before being hygienically packed and sealed to lock in freshness and purity.
